I need to compute (61 - 25) × 3 using the Calculator app. Let me plan this carefully based on the lesson: when an expression mixes addition and multiplication, I should press Equals after the addition to resolve that part before entering the multiplication.

So the plan is:
1. Enter 61
2. Press Subtract (减)
3. Enter 25
4. Press Equals (等于) to compute 61 - 25 = 36
5. Press Multiply (乘)
6. Enter 3
7. Press Equals (等于) to compute 36 × 3 = 108
